articles.title: Un-Mused: How a Single Debug Setting Bypassed macOS Security in Meta’s AI Client
articles.author: Olimpiu Pop
articles.summary: Security researcher Patrick Wardle revealed an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in Meta's Muse desktop client for macOS. This flaw lets unprivileged software manipulate the assistant's extensive permissions, compromising input confidentiality and account security. Despite a hotfix from Meta, the vulnerability raises significant concerns about platform trust and security boundaries. By Olimpiu Pop

articles.title: Introducing enhanced custom event buses in Amazon EventBridge for enterprise-scale event-driven applications
articles.author: Micah Walter
articles.summary: Amazon EventBridge announces an enhanced custom event bus for organizations scaling event-driven applications across teams and accounts. Deploy a single event bus shared across all AWS accounts in your organization, with ordering guarantees, a simplified Subscriber resource, and improved economics at scale.
